provenance.source_layer_snpp_note: Suomi NPP DNB GIBS layers are a historical archive with gaps only; the SNPP data supply terminated 2026-11-01
provenance.distribution: NASA EOSDIS GIBS public WMTS (no authentication)
provenance.browser_grid_semantics: display sampling at WMTS tile level 6; native source remains 500 m
provenance.cloud_caveat: daily raw DNB contains cloud contamination; this is NOT a cloud-free composite and GIBS rendered tiles carry no per-pixel quality flags
provenance.laads_dead_end: legacy LAADS VNP46A4 path is a dead end: Suomi NPP data supply was terminated 2026-11-01 and VNP46A4 is an SNPP product (product lifecycle end-of-life), so the annual composite can no longer be sourced
provenance.semantics: satellite-observed daily nighttime-light radiance; not Bortle class and not zenith sky brightness
